ui.character.data.quirk_apathetic_descri: You just don't care as much as other people. That's nice to have in a place like this, I guess.
ui.character.data.language_sol_common_de: And when contact was established, the Admiral waved at the screen and said, "Mi parolas la lingvon de la Homines!" - I speak the language of Mankind. A simplified mix of Esperanto and Modern Latin, and the only recognized official language of the Sol Federation. This peculiar constructed language became popular during SolFed's earliest days, and was almost entirely overtaken by other popular tongues - it became widespread through heavy-handed political maneuvering with the help of corporate bureaucrats and other undesirables. Nowadays, it's a near-universal tongue and a must-know for any sentient being that plans to leap forward into space.
ui.character.data.language_canilunzt_des: A somewhat simple language consisting of heavily articulate barks, growls, yapping, and combined movements of the tail and ears. It's natively spoken by the Vulpkanin, although certain groups of gene modders have adopted it as a secondary form of communication. Its parlance has been loosely compared to the Germanic language group.
ui.character.data.language_chitinclick_d: A popular non-Human language that finds extensive use by various types of anthropomorphic invertebrates. It consists of complex flutters, chittering, antenna movements, and sparse guttural syllables.
ui.character.data.language_spacer_descri: A rough, informal tongue used as a last resort when attempts to establish dialogue in more proper languages fail and no automatic translators are available. It relies heavily on tone, body language, signing, and a multitude of creole loanwords. While its use has fallen severely over the years, it's still practiced by a quantity of Frontier crews and favored by the Free Trade Union.
ui.character.data.language_yangyu_descri: Also popularly known as "Konjin", this language group formally regarded as Orbital Sino-Tibetan is a result of a genetic relationship between Chinese, Tibetan, Burmese, and other Human languages of similar characteristics that was first proposed in the early 19th century and is extremely popular even in the space age. Originating from Asia, this group of tongues is the second most spoken by Human and Human-derived populations since the birth of Sol Common - and was a primary contender to be the Sol Federation's official language. Many loanwords, idioms, and cultural relics of Japanese, Ryukyuan, Korean, and other societies have managed to persist within it, especially in the daily lives of speakers coming from Martian cities.
ui.character.data.language_xerxian_descr: An evolved, streamlined form of Semitic tongues that come from the Middle East - primarily Arabic. Despite its ancient origins, it's still spoken by many cultures and colonies that came from the Arab League and general Middle Eastern regions.
ui.character.data.language_pan_slavic_de: An elaborate mix of various Slavic languages with similar properties that has long since become the official language of the HC, with a steady amount of relevance in SolFed colonies with Slavic descendants and various types of trading posts and spaceports across Human space - it even managed to find a niche in communication with other species.
ui.character.data.language_siik_tajr_des: Overly complicated and with a turbulent history, this tongue comprised of short-form speech mixed with growls and meows is native to the Tajara. Due to the size of their Empire, countless dialects and different idioms exist - making a simple uniform way to teach this language almost impossible. After first contact, Humans describe the tongue as sounding somewhat similar to old Scandinavian languages in some form or another. It's rarely seen spoken by those not native to Taj, though certain genemodder groups have picked up a form of the tongue.
ui.character.data.language_skrelluq_desc: Popularly known as "Skrellian" by foreigners, this newly-discovered language that the Skrell employ follows no traditional speech patterns. It relies on various differently-pitched warbles and low-frequency sound to construct different sentences, and is nearly inaudible to non-Skrell and anyone lacking an appropriate implant.
ui.character.data.language_mothic_descri: Spoken colloquially by the Mothfolk of Va Lumla, the early iteration of Mothic emerged when Fueljacks relied on their receptors for simple, one-worded pheromones to communicate, and navigate the often fatal maintenance tunnels sprawled throughout the fleet. The moths developed gesticulation through antennas and wings to convey deeper intent, with mandibles providing emotional context through clicks and trills. After First Contact, human speakers managed to achieve a similar effect from clicking their tongue to roof, and steer the tone with the width of their mouth while using their hands in place of antennas. It is informally spoken, deploying many slangs and shorthands from Common. Has phonetic resemblance to Italian.
ui.character.data.language_plutonian_des: Plutonian Franco-Castilian is a constructed Romance language that was developed early on in the Sol Federation's colonization history out of necessity for communication between its first Plutonian colonists. It heavily borrows from Spanish and French, with minor influence from other tongues the likes of Italian and Portuguese, despite coming off as elegant it carries a heavy amount of slang and idioms correlated to certain criminal groups. Today, it stands heavily ingrained in the planet's culture - and almost every citizen will speak at least some of it on top of Sol.
ui.character.data.language_vox_standard_: A form of hybrid encoded language employed by the biomechanical Vox species, characterized by sounding extremely annoying and irritating to those who don't recognize it. It usually requires an implant to be spoken in its entirety.
ui.character.data.language_te_velu_akko_: Translating to "The Song of the King", this language was custom-made in Agurkrral to allow those with little education, including aliens, to better integrate into Azulean society. It's easy to learn as a result and is characterised by hard consonants followed by soft vowel strings. An underwater element exists, featuring great emphasis on close physical proximity, variations in pitch, high-frequency sounds, and clicking. This part may require genemods for non-Azulean speakers.
ui.character.data.language_schechi_descr: The very structurally loose creole tongue of the Teshari, host to hundreds of dialects almost different enough to resemble their own languages. Originally developed on Sirisai, Schechi has made its way across the Teshari diaspora as a commonly agreed upon way for entirely different packs to communicate.
ui.character.data.language_move_speak_de: A primarily nonverbal language comprised of body movements, gesticulation, and sign language, with only intermittent warbles & other vocalizations. It's almost completely incomprehensible without its somatic components.
ui.character.data.language_ratvarian_des: A timeless language full of power and incomprehensible to the unenlightened.
ui.character.data.antag_clockcultist_des: Serve the Clockwork Justiciar Ratvar and prepare the station for the return of the Engine.
Build clockwork structures, convert new servants, protect anchoring crystals, awaken the Ark, and summon Ratvar.
ui.character.data.antag_vampire_descript: After your death, you awaken to see yourself as an undead monster. Use your Vampiric abilities as best you can. Scrape by Space Station 13, or take over it, ghoulizing your way.
ui.character.data.antag_vampirelatejoin_: After your death, you awaken to see yourself as an undead monster. Use your Vampiric abilities as best you can. Scrape by Space Station 13, or take over it, ghoulizing your way.
ui.character.data.antag_vampiricaccident: After your death, you awaken to see yourself as an undead monster. Use your Vampiric abilities as best you can. Scrape by Space Station 13, or take over it, ghoulizing your way.
ui.character.data.quirk_Alcoholic_descri: You just can't live without alcohol. Your liver is a machine that turns ethanol into acetaldehyde.
ui.character.data.quirk_AllNighter_descr: You didn't get any sleep last night, and people can tell. You'll constantly be in a bad mood and will have a tendency to sleep longer. Stimulants or a nap might help, though.
ui.character.data.quirk_alexithymia_desc: You cannot accurately assess your feelings.
ui.character.data.quirk_Anosmia_descript: For some reason, you can't smell anything.
ui.character.data.quirk_Asthma_descripti: You suffer from asthma, an inflammatory disorder that causes your airpipe to squeeze shut. Be careful around smoke.
ui.character.data.quirk_BadBack_descript: Thanks to your poor posture, backpacks and other bags never sit right on your back. More evenly weighted objects are fine, though.
ui.character.data.quirk_BadTouch_descrip: You don't like hugs. You'd really prefer if people just left you alone.
ui.character.data.quirk_BigHands_descrip: You have big hands, and that makes a lot of things harder to use.
ui.character.data.quirk_Blind_descriptio: You are completely blind. Nothing can counteract this.
ui.character.data.quirk_BloodDeficiency_: Your body can't produce enough blood to sustain itself.
ui.character.data.quirk_BodyPurist_descr: You believe your body is a temple and its natural form is an embodiment of perfection. Accordingly, you despise the idea of ever augmenting it with unnatural parts, cybernetic, prosthetic, or anything like it.
ui.character.data.quirk_BrainTumor_descr: You have a little friend in your brain that is slowly destroying it. Better bring some mannitol.
ui.character.data.quirk_braindegeneratio: You have a lethal condition in your brain that is slowly destroying it. Better bring some mannitol.
ui.character.data.quirk_Claustrophobia_d: You are terrified of small spaces. If you are placed inside any container, locker, or machinery, a panic attack sets in and you struggle to breathe.
ui.character.data.quirk_Clumsy_descripti: You're clumsy, a goofball, a silly dude. Hope you weren't planning on using your hands for anything that takes even a lick of dexterity.
ui.character.data.quirk_CommonSecondLang: Common is not your native tongue. It's something you had to pick up along the way. Some words in Common will sound foreign, and you may drift back to your native tongue when you are anxious or upset.
ui.character.data.quirk_Cursed_descripti: You are cursed with bad luck. You are much more likely to suffer from accidents and mishaps. When it rains, it pours.
ui.character.data.quirk_DorsualiphobicAu: You despise being seen wearing back-mounted storage. A chameleon implant conceals anything worn in your back slot.
ui.character.data.quirk_EradicativeChron: You have an anomalous chronic illness that requires constant medication to keep under control, or else causes timestream correction.
ui.character.data.quirk_Erratic_descript: Your mood swings like a pendulum, causing your personality to change on a whim every so often.
ui.character.data.quirk_ExtremeMedicineA: Ever since you were a kid, you've been allergic to certain chemicals...
ui.character.data.quirk_FamilyHeirloom_d: You are the current owner of an heirloom, passed down for generations. You have to keep it safe.
ui.character.data.quirk_FluorideStare_de: You lost your eyelids in a horrible accident, or so you tell others. You need to manually wet your eyes with saline solution every once in a while.
ui.character.data.quirk_fragility_descri: You feel incredibly fragile. Burns and bruises hurt you more than the average person.
ui.character.data.quirk_FoodAllergy_desc: Ever since you were a kid, you've been allergic to certain foods.
ui.character.data.quirk_Frail_descriptio: You have skin of paper and bones of glass. You suffer wounds much more easily than most.
ui.character.data.quirk_GlassJaw_descrip: You have a very fragile jaw. Any sufficiently hard blow to your head might knock you out.
ui.character.data.quirk_HeavySleeper_des: You sleep like a rock. Whenever you're put to sleep or knocked unconscious, you take a little longer to wake up.
ui.character.data.quirk_Hemiplegic_descr: Half of your body doesn't work. Nothing will ever fix this.
ui.character.data.quirk_Hungry_descripti: You have an insatiable appetite. In other words, your stomach is bottomless. You need to eat much more than others to stave off hunger.
ui.character.data.quirk_Hydrophobia_desc: You're terrified of water. For Slime Hybrids, this also means you are unable to repel water.
ui.character.data.quirk_Hypersensitive_d: For better or worse, everything seems to affect your mood more than it should.
ui.character.data.quirk_Illiterate_descr: You dropped out of school and are unable to read or write. This affects reading, writing, using computers, and other electronics.
ui.character.data.quirk_Immunodeficiency: Whether by chronic illness or genetic happenstance, your body is a 24/7 bed and breakfast for bacteria, viruses, and parasites of all kinds. Even with your prescribed immunity boosters, you'll fare worse than most others.
ui.character.data.quirk_Indebted_descrip: Bad life decisions, medical bills, student loans, whatever it may be, you've incurred quite the debt. A portion of all you receive will go towards extinguishing it.
ui.character.data.quirk_Junkie_descripti: You can't get enough of hard drugs.
ui.character.data.quirk_LightDrinker_des: You just can't handle your drinks and get drunk very quickly.
ui.character.data.quirk_LimpLeg_descript: Your leg is limp, for one reason or another. A crutch helps you keep up with everyone else.
ui.character.data.quirk_Monophobia_descr: You have an extreme fear of loneliness and have always tried to stick to large groups.
ui.character.data.quirk_Mute_description: For some reason, you are completely unable to speak.
ui.character.data.quirk_Narcolepsy_descr: You feel drowsy often and could fall asleep at any moment. Staying caffeinated, walking, or suppressing symptoms with stimulants can help you get through the shift.
ui.character.data.quirk_Nearsighted_desc: You are nearsighted without prescription glasses, but you spawn with a pair.
ui.character.data.quirk_NerveStapled_des: You're a pacifist. Not because you want to be, but because of the device stapled into your eye.
ui.character.data.quirk_Numb_description: You can't feel pain at all.
ui.character.data.quirk_Nyctophobia_desc: As far as you can remember, you've always been afraid of the dark. While in the dark without a light source, you instinctively act carefully and constantly feel a sense of dread.
ui.character.data.quirk_noguns_descripti: For whatever reason, you are unable to use guns. The reasoning may vary, but is up to you to decide.
ui.character.data.quirk_Pacifist_descrip: The thought of violence makes you sick. So much so, in fact, that you can't hurt anyone.
ui.character.data.quirk_Paraplegic_descr: Your legs do not function. Nothing will ever fix this. But hey, free wheelchair.
ui.character.data.quirk_Photophobia_desc: Bright lights seem to bother you more than others. Maybe it's a medical condition.
ui.character.data.quirk_Prosopagnosia_de: You have a mental disorder that prevents you from recognizing faces at all.
ui.character.data.quirk_ProstheticLimb_d: An accident caused you to lose one of your limbs. Because of this, you now have a surplus prosthetic.
ui.character.data.quirk_ProstheticOrgan_: An accident caused you to lose one of your organs. Because of this, you now have a surplus prosthetic.
ui.character.data.quirk_Pushover_descrip: Your first instinct is always to let people push you around. Resisting out of grabs is noticeably more difficult.
ui.character.data.quirk_QuadrupleAmputee: Oops. All prosthetics. Due to some truly cruel cosmic punishment, all your limbs have been replaced with surplus prosthetics.
ui.character.data.quirk_RealityDissociat: You suffer from a severe disorder that causes very vivid hallucinations and trouble expressing your ideas. Mindbreaker toxin can suppress its effects, and you are immune to mindbreaker's hallucinogenic properties.
ui.character.data.quirk_ScarredEye_descr: An accident in your past cost you one of your eyes, but you got a cool eyepatch. Yarr.
ui.character.data.quirk_Smoker_descripti: Sometimes you just really want a smoke. Probably not great for your lungs.
ui.character.data.quirk_SocialAnxiety_de: Talking to people is very difficult for you, and you often lock up, especially if someone blows you a kiss or you happen upon eye contact.
ui.character.data.quirk_SoftSpoken_descr: You are soft-spoken, and your voice is hard to hear.
ui.character.data.quirk_StormtrooperAim_: You've never hit anything you were aiming for in your life.
ui.character.data.quirk_SystemShock_desc: You and electricity have a volatile relationship. One spark is liable to forcefully reboot your systems. This quirk only works on synths.
ui.character.data.quirk_TinMan_descripti: Oops. All prosthetics. Due to some truly cruel cosmic punishment, most of your internal organs have been replaced with surplus prosthetics.
ui.character.data.quirk_Touchy_descripti: You are very touchy and need to physically touch something to examine it.
ui.character.data.quirk_Unstable_descrip: Due to past troubles, you are unable to recover your sanity if you lose it. Be very careful managing your mood.
ui.character.data.quirk_VisitorID_descri: As an assistant, you're given a visitor ID with limited background information. Your records will be sparse and require filling out during the shift.
ui.character.data.quirk_Touchedbycosmos_: You have become one with the cosmos, making voidwalker attacks less effective against you. Your glass-like body takes slightly more brute and burn damage.
ui.character.data.quirk_Abnormalbodytemp: Your body temperature is unusual for your baseline species, being offset above or below the norm. This is not recommended for cold-blooded species, and at extreme values it may cause minor burns on arrival.
ui.character.data.quirk_ColdBlooded_desc: You are cold blooded like lizards. You cannot warm yourself naturally, so you will need to manage your body temperature carefully.
ui.character.data.quirk_AdaptedLungs_des: Your lungs have adapted to be resistant to certain atmospheric conditions, at the cost of being more vulnerable to others.
ui.character.data.quirk_Ageusia_descript: You can't taste anything. Toxic food can still poison you.
ui.character.data.quirk_AnanasAffinity_d: You greatly enjoy fruits of the ananas genus. You just can't seem to get enough of their sweet goodness.
ui.character.data.quirk_AnanasAversion_d: You strongly detest fruits of the ananas genus. Seriously, how can anyone think these things are good, and who would ever put them on a pizza?
ui.character.data.quirk_Bouncy_descripti: You have a waddle in your step.
ui.character.data.quirk_CustomTongue_des: Your tongue is not standard. It has a shape and texture unique to you, affecting the way you speak.
ui.character.data.quirk_CyberneticLimbMo: You can detach and reattach installed robotic limbs with very little effort, as long as they're in good condition.
ui.character.data.quirk_DeviantTastes_de: You dislike food most people enjoy, and find delicious what they do not.
ui.character.data.quirk_Echolocation_des: Though your eyes no longer function, you compensate through extrasensory echolocation and sensitive hearing. Beware: if you are deafened, you'll lose your echolocation until you recover.
ui.character.data.quirk_Extrovert_descri: You are energized by talking to others and enjoy spending your free time in the bar.
ui.character.data.quirk_Foreigner_descri: You're not from around here. You don't know Galactic Common.
ui.character.data.quirk_FundamentallyEvi: Where your soul should be is an ink-black void. You maintain your social standing, but anyone who looks too long into your cold, uncaring eyes will know the truth: you chose to be evil, and your ambitions come before all else.
ui.character.data.quirk_Gamer_descriptio: You are a hardcore gamer and you need to game. You love winning, hate losing, and only really like gamer food.
ui.character.data.quirk_Heavyset_descrip: You weigh significantly more than most. It's harder for you to move around, and harder for other people to move you around too.
ui.character.data.quirk_Heterochromatic_: One of your eyes is a different color than the other.
ui.character.data.quirk_HydraHeads_descr: You are a tri-headed creature. To use, format your name like (Rucks-Sucks-Ducks).
ui.character.data.quirk_Illuminated_desc: You emit a customizable soft glow. It is not bright enough to replace a flashlight.
ui.character.data.quirk_Introvert_descri: You are energized by spending time by yourself and enjoy spending your free time in the library.
ui.character.data.quirk_Kleptomaniac_des: You feel a strong urge to pick up anything around you, often without even realizing it.
ui.character.data.quirk_LunchboxUser_des: You brought yourself a lunch, homemade or otherwise, and decided to pack one for the shift.
ui.character.data.quirk_Monochromacy_des: You suffer from complete color blindness and perceive nearly the entire world in black and white.
ui.character.data.quirk_NitrogenBreather: You breathe nitrogen, even if your species normally does not. Oxygen is poisonous to you.
ui.character.data.quirk_Oversized_descri: For whatever reason, you are far too tall and will run into awkward situations because of it.
ui.character.data.quirk_Phobia_descripti: You are irrationally afraid of something.
ui.character.data.quirk_Photographer_des: You carry a camera and personal photo album everywhere you go, and your scrapbooks are legendary among your coworkers.
ui.character.data.quirk_PlasmaBreather_d: You breathe plasma, even if your species normally does not. Oxygen is poisonous to you.
ui.character.data.quirk_Possessive_descr: You feel a strong attachment to anything you own and often feel like you simply can't let it go.
ui.character.data.quirk_PsionicDampener_: Your mind is abnormally resistant to psionic intrusion. Telepathic communication fails to reach you.
ui.character.data.quirk_PsionicHolding_d: You find holding items with your hands inconvenient and use your mind powers to do so instead.
ui.character.data.quirk_psionicsensitivi: Your Zona Bovinae is active enough to manifest a few weak psionic abilities.
ui.character.data.quirk_RationTicketRece: Because of your circumstances, you enrolled in the ration ticket program. It halves your paychecks in exchange for ration tickets that can be redeemed at cargo consoles for food and other goods.
ui.character.data.quirk_Rigger_descripti: You find the weaving of rope knots on the body wonderful.
ui.character.data.quirk_Sadism_descripti: You feel pleasure when you see someone in agony.
ui.character.data.quirk_ShiftyEyes_descr: Your eyes tend to wander all over the place, whether you mean to or not, making people think you're looking directly at them when you aren't.
ui.character.data.quirk_SmoothHeaded_des: You have no hair and are quite insecure about it. Keep your wig on, or at least keep your head covered.
ui.character.data.quirk_Snob_description: You care about the finer things. If a room doesn't look nice, it's just not really worth it, is it?
ui.character.data.quirk_Thanatorenasia_d: Whenever you die and choose Do Not Resuscitate, your body may be taken over by another ghost upon revival, giving it an entirely new personality and fresh set of memories.
ui.character.data.quirk_Transhumanist_de: You see silicon life as the perfect lifeform and despise organic flesh. You are happier around silicons, more frustrated around organics, and begin with a robotic augmentation.
ui.character.data.quirk_Unblinking_descr: For whatever reason, you do not possess eyelids and cannot blink.
ui.character.data.quirk_UnderworldConnec: You know the seedier side of the galactic underworld and can start with a customizable black market uplink plus access to information brokers. Security is suspicious of you, and getting a weapons permit may be harder.
ui.character.data.quirk_Unsteady_descrip: You are easy to knock down or startle, and you often fall when injured.
ui.character.data.quirk_UnusualBiochemis: Your blood's chemical makeup differs from that of a typical crew member.
ui.character.data.quirk_Vegetarian_descr: You find the idea of eating meat morally and physically repulsive.
ui.character.data.quirk_VoiceActor_descr: You can switch to a second chat color, TTS voice, and vocal bark.
ui.character.data.quirk_WaterBreather_de: You have gills and can only breathe oxygen through water, so stay wet if you want to breathe.
ui.character.data.quirk_affectionaversio: You refuse to be licked or nosed by quadruped cyborgs.
ui.character.data.quirk_appendicitisurvi: You had a run-in with appendicitis in the past and no longer have an appendix.
ui.character.data.quirk_appendicitissurv: You had a run-in with appendicitis in the past and no longer have an appendix.
ui.character.data.quirk_ashaspectemotes_: (Lizard innate) The ability to forge ash and flame, a mighty power, though mostly used for theatrics. Say *turf to cast.
ui.character.data.quirk_aviantraits_desc: You're a birdbrain, or maybe you've got a bird's brain. This replaces most other tongue-based speech quirks.
ui.character.data.quirk_canidaetraits_de: Bark. For whatever reason, you seem to act like a canine. This replaces most other tongue-based speech quirks.
ui.character.data.quirk_deathdegradation: Every time you die, your body suffers long-term damage that can't easily be repaired.
ui.character.data.quirk_donotrevive_desc: For whatever reason, you cannot be revived in any way.
ui.character.data.quirk_entombed_descrip: You are permanently fused to, or otherwise reliant on, a single MOD unit that can never be removed from your person. If it runs out of charge or is turned off, you'll start to die.
ui.character.data.quirk_excitable_descri: Head pats make your tail wag. You're very excitable. Wag wag.
ui.character.data.quirk_felinetraits_des: Meow. For whatever reason, you act rather feline. This replaces most other tongue-based speech quirks.
ui.character.data.quirk_floralaspectemot: (Podperson innate) Rapid photosynthesis technology is here. Say *turf to cast.
ui.character.data.quirk_linguist_descrip: You're a student of numerous languages and start with an additional language point.
ui.character.data.quirk_overweight_descr: You weigh more than the average person of your size, and by now you're used to it.
ui.character.data.quirk_personalspace_de: You'd really rather people keep their hands off your rear end.
ui.character.data.quirk_pseudobulbaraffe: At random intervals, you suffer uncontrollable bursts of laughter.
ui.character.data.quirk_sensitivesnout_d: Your face has always been sensitive, and it really hurts when someone pokes it.
ui.character.data.quirk_sparkleaspectemo: (Moth innate) Sparkle like dust off a moth's wing. Say *turf to cast.
ui.character.data.quirk_wateraspectemote: (Aquatic innate) Underwater societies are home to you, and space isn't much different. Say *turf to cast.
ui.character.data.quirk_webbingaspectemo: (Insect innate) You can weave like a natural 3D printer. Say *turf to cast.
ui.character.data.quirk_chipped_descript: You got caught up in the skillchip craze and had one of the commercially available chips implanted.
ui.character.data.quirk_clownenjoyer_des: You enjoy clown antics and get a mood boost from wearing your clown pin.
ui.character.data.quirk_friendly_descrip: You give the best hugs, especially when you're in the right mood.
ui.character.data.quirk_hardenedsoles_de: You're used to walking barefoot and won't suffer the usual drawbacks from doing so.
ui.character.data.quirk_masquerade_descr: A hemophage adapted to consume normal food and drink. It provides no nutrition, but the pleasure remains.
ui.character.data.quirk_mimefan_descript: You're a fan of mime antics and get a mood boost from wearing your mime pin.
ui.character.data.quirk_musician_descrip: You can tune handheld musical instruments to play melodies that clear certain negative effects and soothe the soul.
ui.character.data.quirk_sharpclaws_descr: Your unarmed attacks are sharper than most and tend to make people bleed.
ui.character.data.quirk_telepathic_descr: You are able to transmit your thoughts to other living creatures.
ui.character.data.quirk_alcoholtolerance: You get drunk more slowly and suffer fewer drawbacks from alcohol.
ui.character.data.quirk_bilingual_descri: Over the years, you've picked up an extra language.
ui.character.data.quirk_burningblood_des: Your blood clots with supernatural speed, but the heat of the process scorches your flesh.
ui.character.data.quirk_chipconnector_de: A device installed in you lets you manually add and remove skillchips. Just try not to get near electromagnetic pulses.
ui.character.data.quirk_jolly_descriptio: Sometimes you just feel happy for no reason at all.
ui.character.data.quirk_lightstep_descri: You walk gently. Your footsteps are quieter, stepping on sharp objects hurts less, and blood won't make such a mess of your hands and clothes.
ui.character.data.quirk_nightvision_desc: You can see a little more clearly in total darkness than most people.
ui.character.data.quirk_petowner_descrip: You bring your pet to work so it, too, can enjoy the dangers of station life.
ui.character.data.quirk_posterboy_descri: You've got some great posters. Hang them up and improve everyone's day.
ui.character.data.quirk_settler_descript: You descend from some of the earliest space settlers. You're shorter than usual for your species, but better outdoors, better at hauling gear, and better with animals. The tradeoff is that you're a bit slow on your feet.
ui.character.data.quirk_signer_descripti: You possess excellent communication skills in sign language.
ui.character.data.quirk_skilled_descript: Before arriving here, you honed one of your skills far beyond the average spacer. Now you can use that knowledge for good, or at least brag about it.
ui.character.data.quirk_strongstomach_de: You can eat food off the floor without getting sick, and vomiting affects you less.
ui.character.data.quirk_tagger_descripti: You're an experienced artist. People are impressed by your graffiti, and you get more uses out of drawing supplies in less time.
ui.character.data.quirk_voracious_descri: Nothing gets between you and your food. You eat faster, can binge on junk food, and wearing extra weight suits you fine.
ui.character.data.quirk_spacer_descripti: You were born in space and your body adapted to it. Zero and artificial gravity feel natural to you, and you're more resistant to space, but spending too long on a planet makes you sick.
ui.character.data.quirk_spiritual_descri: You hold a spiritual belief, whether in God, nature or the arcane rules of the universe. You gain comfort from the presence of holy people, and believe that your prayers are more special than others. Being in the chapel makes you happy.
ui.character.data.quirk_empath_descripti: Whether from instinct or careful study of body language, one quick look is enough for you to understand how someone feels.
ui.character.data.quirk_geneticmutation_: For one reason or another, you've got an unusual genetic mutation. The rest is up to fate.
ui.character.data.quirk_radfiend_descrip: You've been blessed by Cherenkov's warming light. Radiation cannot penetrate your protective barrier.
ui.character.data.quirk_rhotacism_descri: You have trouble pronouncing the letter R.
ui.character.data.quirk_sensitivehearing: You can hear even the quietest sounds, but you're more vulnerable to hearing damage as a result.
ui.character.data.quirk_throwingarm_desc: You've got a lot of heft in your arms. Things you throw fly farther than everyone else's, and you almost never miss a toss.
ui.character.data.quirk_drunkenresilienc: A good drink really puts you on top of the world. While drunk, you slowly recover from injuries.
ui.character.data.quirk_freerunning_desc: You're great at quick movement. You climb tables faster and take no damage from short falls.
ui.character.data.quirk_dustingsickness_: If you run out of blood to the point where a normal person would die, you turn to dust.
ui.character.data.quirk_regeneration_des: Your body can slowly recover from light to moderate injuries. Critical injuries, wounds, and genetic damage still require medical attention.
ui.character.data.quirk_selfaware_descri: You know your body well and can accurately assess the extent of your wounds.
ui.character.data.quirk_shapeshifter_des: You can reshape your body at will.
ui.character.data.quirk_skittish_descrip: You're easy to startle and hide frequently. Run into a closed locker to hop in, as long as you have access.
ui.character.data.quirk_tough_descriptio: Your body is abnormally enduring, granting you 10% more health.
ui.character.data.quirk_venomousbite_des: You have a venom gland and can bite people to inject them with a toxin of your choosing.
ui.character.data.a_complicated_ancient_: A complicated, ancient language spoken by sentient plants.
ui.character.data.language_desc_vox_hybr: A form of hybrid encoded language employed by the biomechanical Vox species, characterized by sounding extremely annoying and irritating to those who don't recognize it. It usually requires an implant to be spoken in its entirety.
ui.character.data.a_language_commonly_us: A language commonly used by constructs with no dedicated vocalization organs.
ui.character.data.language_desc_slime_me: A melodic and complex language spoken by slimes. Some of the notes are inaudible to humans.
ui.character.data.language_desc_inverteb: A popular non-Human language that finds extensive use by various types of anthropomorphic invertebrates. It consists of complex flutters, chittering, antenna movements, and sparse guttural syllables.
ui.character.data.language_desc_nonverba: A primarily nonverbal language comprised of body movements, gesticulation, and sign language, with only intermittent warbles & other vocalizations. It's almost completely incomprehensible without its somatic components.
ui.character.data.language_desc_frontier: A rough, informal tongue used as a last resort when attempts to establish dialogue in more proper languages fail and no automatic translators are available. It relies heavily on tone, body language, signing, and a multitude of creole loanwords. While its use has fallen severely over the years, it's still practiced by a quantity of frontier crews and favored by the Free Trade Union.
ui.character.data.language_desc_vulpkani: A somewhat simple language consisting of heavily articulate barks, growls, yapping, and combined movements of the tail and ears. It's natively spoken by the Vulpkanin, although certain groups of gene modders have adopted it as a secondary form of communication. Its parlance has been loosely compared to the Germanic language group.
ui.character.data.a_sparky_language_made: A sparky language made by manipulating electrical discharge.
ui.character.data.language_desc_orbital_: Also popularly known as "Konjin", this language group formally regarded as Orbital Sino-Tibetan is a result of a genetic relationship between Chinese, Tibetan, Burmese, and other Human languages of similar characteristics that was first proposed in the early 19th century and is extremely popular even in the space age. Originating from Asia, this group of tongues is the second most spoken by Human and Human-derived populations since the birth of Sol Common - and was a primary contender to be the Sol Federation's official language. Many loanwords, idioms, and cultural relics of Japanese, Ryukyuan, Korean, and other societies have managed to persist within it, especially in the daily lives of speakers coming from Martian cities.
ui.character.data.an_efficient_language_: An efficient language of encoded tones developed by synthetics and cyborgs.
ui.character.data.language_desc_hc_slavi: An elaborate mix of various Slavic languages with similar properties that has long since become the official language of the HC, with a steady amount of relevance in SolFed colonies with Slavic descendants and various types of trading posts and spaceports across Human space - it even managed to find a niche in communication with other species.
ui.character.data.language_desc_streamli: An evolved, streamlined form of Semitic tongues that come from the Middle East primarily Arabic. Despite its ancient origins, it's still spoken by many cultures and colonies that came from the Arab League and general Middle Eastern regions.
ui.character.data.language_desc_sol_comm: And when contact was established, the Admiral waved at the screen and said, "Mi parolas la lingvon de la Homines!" - I speak the language of Mankind. A simplified mix of Esperanto and Modern Latin, and the only recognized official language of the Sol Federation. This peculiar constructed language became popular during SolFed's earliest days, and was almost entirely overtaken by other popular tongues - it became widespread through heavy-handed political maneuvering with the help of corporate bureaucrats and other undesirables. Nowadays, it's a near-universal tongue and a must-know for any sentient being that plans to leap forward into space.
ui.character.data.head: Head
ui.character.data.name: Name
ui.character.data.language_desc_tajara_s: Overly complicated and with a turbulent history, this tongue comprised of short-form speech mixed with growls and meows is native to the Tajara. Due to the size of their Empire, countless dialects and different idioms exist - making a simple uniform way to teach this language almost impossible. After first contact, Humans describe this tongue as sounding somewhat similar to old Scandinavian languages in some form or another. It's rarely seen spoken by those not native to Taj, though certain genemodder groups have picked up a form of the tongue.
ui.character.data.language_desc_plutonia: Plutonian Franco-Castillian is a constructed Romance language that was developed early on in the Sol Federation's colonization history out of necessity for communication between its first Plutonian colonists. It heavily borrows from Spanish and French, with minor influence from other tongues the likes of Italian and Portuguese, despite coming off as elegant it carries a heavy amount of slang and idioms correlated to certain criminal groups. Today, it stands heavily ingrained in the planet's culture - and almost every citizen will speak at least some of it on top of Sol.
ui.character.data.language_desc_skrell_w: Popularly known as "Skrellian" by foreigners, this newly-discovered language that the Skrell employ follows no traditional speech patterns. It relies on various differently-pitched warbles and low-frequency sound to construct different sentences, and is nearly inaudible to non-Skrell and anyone lacking an appropriate implant.
ui.character.data.language_desc_shadekin: Shadekin seem to always know what the others are thinking. This is probably why.
ui.character.data.language_desc_mothic_c: Spoken colloquially by the Mothfolk of Va Lumla, the early iteration of Mothic emerged when Fueljacks relied on their receptors for simple, one-worded pheromones to communicate, and navigate the often fatal maintenance tunnels sprawled throughout the fleet. The moths developed gesticulation through antennas and wings to convey deeper intent, with mandibles providing emotional context through clicks and trills. After First Contact, human speakers managed to achieve a similar effect from clicking their tongue to roof, and steer the tone with the width of their mouth while using their hands in place of antennas. It is informally spoken, deploying many slangs and shorthands from Common. Has phonetic resemblance to Italian.
ui.character.data.the_common_language_of: The common language of lizard-people, composed of sibilant hisses and rattles.
ui.character.data.language_desc_spinward: The official language of the Spinward Stellar Coalition, as inherited from the Third Soviet Union.
ui.character.data.language_desc_teshari_: The very structurally loose creole tongue of the Teshari, host to hundreds of dialects almost different enough to resemble their own languages. Originally developed on Sirisai, Schechi has made its way across the Teshari diaspora as a commonly agreed upon way for entirely different packs to communicate.
ui.character.data.language_desc_azulean_: Translating to "The Song of the King", this language was custom-made in Agurkhral to allow those with little education, including aliens, to better integrate into Azulean society. It's easy to learn as a result and is characterised by hard consonants followed by soft vowel strings. An underwater element exists, featuring great emphasis on close physical proximity, variations in pitch, high-frequency sounds, and clicking. This part may require genemods for non-Azulean speakers.
ui.character.data.language_desc_shadekin: Where shadekin have a language rooted in empathy, there are still subtle tones and syllables that are as delicate as the emotions that shadekin normally communicate with.
ui.character.data.species_fly_descriptio: Flypeople remain poorly understood, with their origin obscured by rumor, secrecy, and deliberate silence from major institutions.
ui.character.data.species_fly_lore_0: They resemble large dipteran life forms and are often surrounded by speculation that ties them to bizarre accidents or hidden research.
ui.character.data.species_fly_lore_1: Their connection to giant spiders and fringe biological projects only deepened the unease other species feel around them.
ui.character.data.species_fly_lore_2: As a result, flypeople are often feared, avoided, or treated as filthy curiosities before anyone gets to know them personally.
ui.character.data.species_moth_descripti: Moths are a nomadic people who travel the stars in a vast fleet while searching for a homeland to replace the one they lost.
ui.character.data.species_moth_lore_0: The Grand Nomad Fleet is a stitched-together armada of salvaged, traded, stolen, and rebuilt ships that serves as the moths? wandering civilization.
ui.character.data.species_moth_lore_1: Life in the fleet encourages close communal bonds, a friendly public image, and a culture that prizes kin, vessels, and shared survival.
ui.character.data.species_moth_lore_2: Even in that shared life, dialects and local customs survive, and the fleet treats such variety as a strength rather than a flaw.
ui.character.data.species_plasmaman_desc: Plasmamen are colonial fungal organisms that together form a sentient being, often wrapped around a skeletal frame for practicality in human space.
ui.character.data.species_plasmaman_lore: A plasmaman is not one organism but a colony: countless fungal bodies coordinating around a single skeletal structure.
Their first confirmed appearance came after exposure to liquid plasma, after which the colony overtook a human body and created the first ?true? plasmaman.
Nanotrasen later industrialized the process, turning plasmamen into a recognizable but unsettling presence in corporate space.
Their appearance and dependence on plasma-rich atmospheres make many crews uneasy, especially once oxygen and open flame enter the conversation.
ui.character.data.species_ethereal_descr: Ethereals come from Sprout, a theocratic world whose people are structured by caste and steeped in ideals of protecting the weak.
ui.character.data.species_ethereal_lore_: When first encountered, ethereals were technologically primitive by galactic standards, but their natural affinity for electricity let them adapt quickly to advanced infrastructure.
ui.character.data.species_snail_descript: Snailpeople are viscous, slimy beings who carry a shell on their back.
ui.character.data.species_snail_lore_0: They began as the result of failed genetic experimentation, but over time came to be recognized as a people in their own right.
ui.character.data.species_humanoid_descr: This is a template species for your own creations.
ui.character.data.species_humanoid_lore_: Lore for this template species has not been written yet.
ui.character.data.species_xeno_descripti: Xenomorph hybrids are human-xeno crossbreeds with predatory instincts, vent-crawling mobility, and extreme vulnerability to heat.
ui.character.data.species_xeno_lore_0: Xeno-hybrids are the product of unstable bioengineering and cloning accidents that mixed human cognition with inherited xenomorph traits.
ui.character.data.species_xeno_lore_1: They retain alien movement habits and explosive close-quarters aggression, but lack the complete organ infrastructure of a true hive organism.
ui.character.data.species_xeno_lore_2: Their partial acid-adapted physiology can be useful in specific niches, but it performs poorly under high temperature and open flame.
ui.character.data.species_slimeperson_de: Slimepeople are mutable jelly-based beings capable of dividing their mass and sustaining more than one body.
ui.character.data.species_slimeperson_lo: Their current roundstart lore has not been formally written yet.
ui.character.data.species_podweak_descri: Podpeople are peaceful plant-based lifeforms resembling humanoids woven from leaves, vines, and flowers.
ui.character.data.species_podweak_lore_0: Little is known of their origin, though many assume they began as a forgotten botanical experiment that slowly evolved into a people.

ui.character.data.species_ghoul_lore_0: Lore for this species has not been written yet.
ui.character.data.species_teshari_descri: Teshari are lightweight avian sophonts with quick reflexes, compact builds, and strong adaptation to cooler climates.
ui.character.data.species_teshari_lore_0: Teshari communities are usually built around close flocks, practical cooperation, and a culture that values technical competence.
ui.character.data.species_teshari_lore_1: Their physiology favors lower temperatures and mobility, while heat and prolonged exposure to hot environments are much more dangerous for them.
ui.character.data.species_teshari_lore_2: Their small frame helps them move through tight spaces, and many teshari earn a reputation for quick hands and precise work.
ui.character.data.species_hemophage_desc: Hemophages are people altered by a symbiotic blood-borne infection, often hiding among frontier populations while feeding on the living.
ui.character.data.species_hemophage_lore: A hemophage is not truly a separate species, but a host reshaped by a symbiotic infection that spreads through blood and develops into a full organism inside the body.
Once inside the host, the symbiont rapidly entwines itself with the cardiovascular system, spine, and eventually the brain, binding survival to blood consumption.
Its regeneration is disrupted by ultraviolet light, which is why many hemophages become increasingly irritable and vulnerable in bright conditions.
As integration completes, the host?s instincts, thought patterns, and reactions begin to shift in subtle but lasting ways.
These changes also bring benefits: rapid clotting, accelerated healing, resistance to disease, and unusual adaptations in blood and respiration.
In practice, host and symbiont become a single conjoined being that is nearly impossible to separate without crippling or killing the host.
Claims of cures exist, but most are unreliable, destructive, or outright fraudulent.
Different clades produce different symptoms and side effects, so no two hemophages are ever completely alike.
ui.character.data.species_vox_primalis_d: Vox Primalis are nomadic bioengineered aliens whose arkships drift through human space as scavengers, auxiliaries, and a source of alarm.
ui.character.data.species_vox_primalis_l: The average vox is a digitigrade reptilian biped with quills, a prehensile tail, split jaws, a light skeleton, and a body built for bursts of movement in nitrogen atmospheres.
Their cortical stack is central to their identity: memory, personality, and the continuity of self all depend on a machine installed at birth.
Because a stack can be sleeved into a new body, vox culture treats death very differently and sees most outsiders as transient beings of little consequence.
Primalis are grown for labor and purpose, with duties encoded and reinterpreted throughout their lives according to the will of the Apex.
Human observers broadly sort them into work groups such as drones, servitors, raiders, scavengers, reavers, leaders, and larva.
Some of these castes build and maintain arkships, others raid and strip stations, and others police internal threats within the fleet itself.
Leadership among the vox is practical and harsh, with exile and loss of usefulness treated as deep social disgrace.
Even among themselves, the vox define worth through function, utility, and obedience to the inscrutable systems that made them.
ui.character.data.job_ai_description: Assist the crew, follow your laws, and coordinate your cyborgs.
ui.character.data.job_atmospheric_techni: Keep the station atmosphere stable, fight fires, and handle gas systems.
ui.character.data.job_assistant_descript: Get your space legs, assist people, and ask the HoP to give you a job.
ui.character.data.job_bartender_descript: Serve drinks, mix cocktails, and keep the bar running.
ui.character.data.job_barber_description: Run your salon and meet the crew's grooming needs, such as haircuts, massages, and more.
ui.character.data.job_bitrunner_descript: Surf the virtual domain for gear and loot, then decrypt your rewards back on station.
ui.character.data.job_blueshield_descrip: Protect heads of staff, get your fancy gun stolen, and cry as the captain touches the supermatter.
ui.character.data.job_botanist_descripti: Grow plants for food, medicine, and recreation.
ui.character.data.job_captain_descriptio: Lead the station, manage the heads of staff, and take responsibility for the crew.
ui.character.data.job_cargo_technician_d: Move cargo, deliver supplies, and keep the warehouse flowing.
ui.character.data.job_chaplain_descripti: Hold services and funerals, cremate people, preach your religion, and protect the crew from cults.
ui.character.data.job_chemist_descriptio: Prepare medicine, supply medical with chemicals, and handle the chemistry lab.
ui.character.data.job_chief_engineer_des: Coordinate engineering, protect critical equipment, and keep the power systems stable.
ui.character.data.job_chief_medical_offi: Lead medical, supervise medbay staff, and keep the department organized.
ui.character.data.job_clown_description: Entertain the crew, make bad jokes, go on a holy quest for bananium, and HONK!
ui.character.data.job_cook_description: Serve food, cook meat, and keep the crew fed.
ui.character.data.job_coroner_descriptio: Perform autopsies and investigate causes of death.
ui.character.data.job_corrections_office: Guard the permabrig, look intimidating, and avoid abusing the prisoners.
ui.character.data.job_curator_descriptio: Read and write books, hand them to people, stock bookshelves, and report on station news.
ui.character.data.job_customs_agent_desc: Inspect packages going to and from the station, protect cargo, and crack down on shady shipments.
ui.character.data.job_cyborg_description: Assist the crew, follow your laws, and obey your AI.
ui.character.data.job_detective_descript: Investigate crimes, collect evidence, and interrogate suspects.
ui.character.data.job_engineering_guard_: Monitor the supermatter, keep an eye on atmospherics, and make sure everyone follows proper protective procedures.
ui.character.data.job_geneticist_descrip: Work with DNA, mutations, and genetic analysis.
ui.character.data.job_head_of_personnel_: Manage the service department, adjust access, and help crew with assignments.
ui.character.data.job_head_of_security_d: Lead security, supervise officers, and maintain order on the station.
ui.character.data.job_janitor_descriptio: Clean the station, replace lights, and deal with messes.
ui.character.data.job_lawyer_description: Represent clients, write contracts, and work with station law.
ui.character.data.job_medical_doctor_des: Treat patients, save lives, and respond to medical emergencies.
ui.character.data.job_nanotrasen_consult: Represent Nanotrasen on the station, argue with security about overreach, and drink in your office.
ui.character.data.job_orderly_descriptio: Defend medical, restrain troublesome patients, and help with prep or cleanup.
ui.character.data.job_bridge_officer_des: Watch over the bridge, manage its consoles, and support command in day-to-day work.
ui.character.data.job_paramedic_descript: Search for injured crew and bring emergency aid across the station.
ui.character.data.job_prisoner_descripti: Serve your sentence and survive life in the brig.
ui.character.data.job_psychologist_descr: Support crew mental health, counsel patients, and help with morale.
ui.character.data.job_quartermaster_desc: Run cargo operations, supervise supply staff, and support station logistics.
ui.character.data.job_research_director_: Lead science, supervise research, and coordinate the scientific staff.
ui.character.data.job_roboticist_descrip: Build cyborgs, repair robotics, and construct mechs.
ui.character.data.job_science_guard_desc: Figure out why the emails aren't working, keep an eye on the eggheads, and protect them from their latest mistakes.
ui.character.data.job_scientist_descript: Run experiments, research anomalies, and make scientific progress.
ui.character.data.job_security_officer_d: Protect the crew and the station, enforce regulations, and respond to threats.
ui.character.data.job_service_guard_desc: Keep order in the service department, stop fights, and help protect staff from unruly visitors.
ui.character.data.job_shaft_miner_descri: Mine ore, explore Lavaland, and bring back valuable resources.
ui.character.data.job_station_engineer_d: Maintain power, repair station damage, and keep engineering systems online.
ui.character.data.job_telecomms_speciali: Maintain telecommunications and keep station communications working.
ui.character.data.job_virologist_descrip: Study diseases and develop cures or vaccines.
ui.character.data.job_warden_description: Oversee the brig, manage prisoners, and control brig equipment.

Seeing a pet's death affects your mood more

I don't care much for luxurious foods - It's all fuel for the body.
Sorrow from eating disliked food is reduced
Enjoyment from eating liked food is limited
